```plato

    // Twelve pentagons on twenty vertices: a cube's eight corners plus three
    // mutually perpendicular golden rectangles
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_dodecahedron).
    Dodecahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
    {
        var p = Number.Phi;
        var q = Number.RPhi;
        var points = [Point3D(-1.0, -1.0, -1.0), Point3D(-1.0, -1.0, 1.0),
                      Point3D(-1.0, 1.0, -1.0), Point3D(-1.0, 1.0, 1.0),
                      Point3D(1.0, -1.0, -1.0), Point3D(1.0, -1.0, 1.0),
                      Point3D(1.0, 1.0, -1.0), Point3D(1.0, 1.0, 1.0),
                      Point3D(0.0, -q, -p), Point3D(0.0, -q, p),
                      Point3D(0.0, q, -p), Point3D(0.0, q, p),
                      Point3D(-q, -p, 0.0), Point3D(-q, p, 0.0),
                      Point3D(q, -p, 0.0), Point3D(q, p, 0.0),
                      Point3D(-p, 0.0, -q), Point3D(p, 0.0, -q),
                      Point3D(-p, 0.0, q), Point3D(p, 0.0, q)];
        var faces = [[11, 7, 15, 13, 3], [19, 17, 6, 15, 7], [4, 8, 10, 6, 17],
                     [0, 16, 2, 10, 8], [12, 1, 18, 16, 0], [10, 2, 13, 15, 6],
                     [16, 18, 3, 13, 2], [1, 9, 11, 3, 18], [14, 12, 0, 8, 4],
                     [9, 5, 19, 7, 11], [5, 14, 4, 17, 19], [12, 14, 5, 9, 1]];
        return PolygonMeshOfVertexNumbers(points, faces).ProjectedToUnitSphere;
    }

    // Twenty triangles on twelve vertices: three mutually perpendicular golden
    // rectangles (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_icosahedron).
    Icosahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
    {
        var p = Number.Phi;
        var points = [Point3D(-1.0, p, 0.0), Point3D(1.0, p, 0.0),
                      Point3D(-1.0, -p, 0.0), Point3D(1.0, -p, 0.0),
                      Point3D(0.0, -1.0, p), Point3D(0.0, 1.0, p),
                      Point3D(0.0, -1.0, -p), Point3D(0.0, 1.0, -p),
                      Point3D(p, 0.0, -1.0), Point3D(p, 0.0, 1.0),
                      Point3D(-p, 0.0, -1.0), Point3D(-p, 0.0, 1.0)];
        var faces = [[0, 11, 5], [0, 5, 1], [0, 1, 7], [0, 7, 10], [0, 10, 11],
                     [1, 5, 9], [5, 11, 4], [11, 10, 2], [10, 7, 6], [7, 1, 8],
                     [3, 9, 4], [3, 4, 2], [3, 2, 6], [3, 6, 8], [3, 8, 9],
                     [4, 9, 5], [2, 4, 11], [6, 2, 10], [8, 6, 7], [9, 8, 1]];
        return PolygonMeshOfVertexNumbers(points, faces).ProjectedToUnitSphere;
    }

}
```
